A person answers through approvals ask and attest; the requesting agent carries it with --approval ID, chore_approve pattern, so approval.grant records the person with a proxy stamp. Direct terminal path for a person with a --digest read receipt. Must hold: the verb stays out of policy RULES and RETRY_VERBS, pinned by a test with every rule on and auto_approve_after_retries=1, so no standing rule can approve a template. Also needed: PS.PROVIDERS gets no repo or cfg, so approvals_request must resolve the digest differently for this verb. lanehooks.py line ~155 carries the same dead-end advice. Put the command under the approvals group: surfaces/exemptions.py then needs no edit, and DX-fleet-registry holds surfaces/declared/lanes.py.

data.body:
Fixes bug B8647b69e06: Lane template approval has no working command: launch_template.consent tells the person to run `ddflow approvals request` for a subject and digest, but that command takes only verb, --item, --target and --reason; launch_template.approve is the only writer of an approval.granted for a lane-template subject and it has no caller, so approved() can never pass outside a test Found on SW-launch.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B8647b69e06 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B8647b69e06 --regression-test <test>` first).

Plan (coordinator answers 2026-11-05, relayed to sw-tmplapprove; the operator is being told about this surface and any objection will be relayed). Status: waits for P-remote.auth to release ddflow/services/approvals/sites.py; not queued; re-dispatched by the coordinator when it is free.

Route: one new T2 verb `lane.approve` for targets `lane-template:<name>` and `lane-plugin:<harness>`, state = the current digest. A person answers through `ddflow approvals ask` and `attest`; the requesting agent carries it with `--approval ID`, as chore_approve does, so approval.grant records the person with a proxy stamp. A person at a terminal approves directly with a `--digest` read receipt. The question text shows the template fields or the plugin diff, built from the record, never the agent's words.

Must hold: `lane.approve` stays out of the policy RULES and RETRY_VERBS; a test pins this with every rule on and auto_approve_after_retries=1. A template or plugin edited after the request needs a new approval. An invalid or unknown template is refused.

Known constraints: PS.PROVIDERS gets no repo or cfg, so approvals_request must resolve the digest another way for this verb. Keep the command under the `approvals` group: surfaces/exemptions.py (P-remote.auth) then needs no edit, and surfaces/declared/lanes.py (DX-fleet-registry) is avoided. Fix the dead-end advice in launch_template.consent and in lanehooks._need_consent.

Globs to widen to at claim (coordinator approved): ddflow/api/approvals.py, ddflow/services/approvals/sites.py, ddflow/services/swarm/lanehooks.py, plus what the fix needs, expected: ddflow/surfaces/declared/approvals.py, ddflow/surfaces/parsers/approvals.py, ddflow/surfaces/commands/approvals.py, tests/test_lane_hooks.py, a new lane-approval test file. Regression test first, failing on the unfixed code.
